description: Deployment artifacts, README, and the submission PDF pipeline. Author frontend/vercel.json, both .env.example files, root render.yaml, root README.md, and the submission/ package (content, assets, build-pdf.mjs, capture-screenshots.mjs). This makes backend deployFiles.test.ts go green (ACs 23, 25) and produces the submission PDF (AC 24). Depends on FEAT-002 (deployFiles test + config CONFIG_KEYS), FEAT-003 (guides + link-check-report feed the PDF samples/evidence log) and FEAT-004 (screenshots need the built frontend). Includes design-review finding #1 (two-phase PDF token replacement + build guards) and the Loom-absence NIT.
steps: Deployment files: frontend/vercel.json (the exact JSON from design.md: SPA catch-all rewrite to /index.html + /assets immutable cache + nosniff/referrer headers), frontend/.env.example (VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8787), root render.yaml (web service, buildCommand 'cd backend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build', startCommand 'cd backend && npm start', healthCheckPath /api/health, autoDeploy true, every backend/.env.example key as a - key: entry with secrets ALLOWED_ORIGINS/OPENAI_API_KEY/TAVILY_API_KEY/UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN as sync:false and NODE_VERSION=22), backend/.env.example (fixed parseable format: one KEY=value per line, # comments and blanks allowed, no export/quotes; all 17 config vars; secrets empty, rest hold defaults with PORT=8787 locally).

Confirm backend/test/deployFiles.test.ts (written in FEAT-002) now passes against the created files: .env.example keys subset of render.yaml keys, CONFIG_KEYS equals .env.example keys, no key-shaped secrets, render.yaml contains 'healthCheckPath: /api/health' + the exact build/start strings.

Root README.md: what it is, architecture sketch, local dev (two terminals) with npm --prefix commands written ONE PER LINE and NO && per NIT (e.g. a line `npm --prefix backend install` then a line `npm --prefix backend run dev`), env var table, testing, deploy-to-Render (Blueprint from render.yaml, set secrets, ALLOWED_ORIGINS to the Vercel URL, the one-time TRUST_PROXY confirmation), deploy-to-Vercel (Root Directory frontend, Vite preset, VITE_API_URL, include-outside-root ON), UptimeRobot warm tip, Upstash durable links, adding a curated guide, and the PDF build steps.

submission/ package: submission/package.json (deps puppeteer 23.9.0 + marked 15.0.2; scripts pdf='node build-pdf.mjs', pdf:draft='node build-pdf.mjs --draft', screenshots='node capture-screenshots.mjs'), submission/.npmrc (save-exact=true), submission/links.config.json (VERCEL_URL/RENDER_URL/REPO_URL placeholders + CANDIDATE_EMAIL yadavchandan6103@gmail.com + SUBMISSION_DATE null), submission/content/{01-problem,02-scope,03-how-it-works,04-guide-format,05-samples,06-live-agent,07-use-of-agents,08-evidence-log,09-limitations,10-future,11-screenshots}.md (11 files; 08-evidence-log reuses FEAT-003 corrections), submission/assets/architecture.svg (hand-authored inline SVG, real <text>, no external refs, Browser/Vercel SPA -> Render Express API -> Tavily/OpenAI/Store with SSE arrows), submission/assets/pdf.css (light print theme, system font stack). Run `npm --prefix submission install`.

build-pdf.mjs (ESM, all paths anchored to path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))): load config (warn per YOUR- placeholder, non-fatal), read content/*.md in filename order. Implement design-review finding #1 TWO-PHASE token replacement: (phase 1) replace inline config tokens ({{VERCEL_URL}} etc.) BEFORE marked, HTML-escaped; render each file to HTML and wrap as
; (phase 2) replace block tokens ARCHITECTURE_SVG, SAMPLE_GUIDES (from ../shared/guides/{github,google-workspace,shopify}.json via escapeHtml), LINK_CHECK_TABLE (from ../shared/link-check-report.json), SCREENSHOTS (screenshots/*.jpg as base64 data URIs) AFTER marked by replacing the

{{KEY}}

wrapper paragraphs with raw HTML. THEN fail the build if any {{...}} token remains unreplaced, if <svg or <table or <figure appear escaped anywhere, or if the architecture section is missing a closing . Keep the existing post-checks: size < 10MB, every REQUIRED section id present, an

capture-screenshots.mjs (ESM, same script-relative here): BASE_URL default http://localhost:4173, pre-flight fetch with a clear exit-1 message if the app isn't up, swiftshader WebGL args, viewport 1440x900, JPEG q82 captures 01-landing..07-generate-idle (and 08/09 when CAPTURE_LIVE=1). Capture the real screenshots against a BACKGROUNDED `vite preview` on :4173 (start it as a background process, capture, then STOP it) so the PDF has >=4 real screenshots.

Produce the PDF: with links.config.json still holding placeholders at build time, `node submission/build-pdf.mjs --draft` must succeed and pass all guards; once the user fills real URLs the non-draft `node submission/build-pdf.mjs` produces submission/Composio_OAuth_Guide_Agent_Submission.pdf < 10MB. Record in findings whether a draft or final PDF was produced and that live URLs remain user-supplied (requirements A2).
acceptance_criteria: `npm --prefix backend test -- deployFiles` passes: .env.example keys are a subset of render.yaml env keys, CONFIG_KEYS equals the .env.example keys, no key-shaped secrets in .env.example, and render.yaml contains healthCheckPath /api/health plus the exact build and start strings (AC 23, 25).
`git grep -nE "sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20}|tvly-[A-Za-z0-9]{10}"` returns nothing across the repo (AC 25).

`npm --prefix submission install` exits 0 and `node submission/build-pdf.mjs --draft` produces submission/Composio_OAuth_Guide_Agent_Submission.pdf < 10MB containing all FR12 sections, an inline SVG diagram, the three sample excerpts, and >=4 screenshots, with no Loom/video mention (AC 24).
The two-phase token replacement leaves zero unreplaced {{...}} tokens and no escaped <svg/<table/<figure, and the build fails loudly if any of those or a missing </svg> occur (finding #1).
README local-dev commands are one npm --prefix invocation per line with no && (NIT).
verification: node submission/build-pdf.mjs --draft produces submission/Composio_OAuth_Guide_Agent_Submission.pdf < 10MB passing all guards
